name: TMXKIT Addons for Elementor
author: thememx

sections.description:
tmxkit-addons-for-elementor is a lightweight Elementor addon plugin that provides a set of essential widgets to enhance your WordPress website:

  • Hero Slider – Responsive slider with image, title, subtitle, description, and button.
  • Icon Box – Feature boxes with 5 predefined card styles (Gradient, Minimal, Glass, Dark, Outline), customizable icon, title, description, and link.
  • Image Box – Image with 5 predefined card styles (Gradient, Minimal, Glass, Dark, Outline), badge icon, title, description, and link.
  • Nav Menu – Display WordPress menus with custom layout and styling options.
  • Site Logo – Display the site logo or a custom logo with alignment and max-width options.
  • Advanced Heading – Title with optional subtitle and link.
  • Advanced Button – 10 predefined button styles (Gradient Fill, Outline Modern, Minimal Text, White on Dark, Soft Background, Gradient Border, Pill, Glassmorphism, Classic Solid, Icon Circle) with icon and hover states.
  • Counter – 5 predefined styles (Modern Minimal, Dark, Boxed, Background Image, Split) with an animated number counter that plays on scroll into view.
  • Pricing Table – 5 predefined styles (Clean Minimal, Gradient Highlight, Modern with Icon, Dark, Bordered Classic) with feature list, ribbon badge, and call-to-action button.
  • Testimonial – Star rating, photo, quote, name and role.
  • Team Member – Photo, bio, and social links.
  • Call to Action – Background image/color banner with title, text, and button.
  • Progress Bar – Animated skill/progress bar.
  • FAQ Accordion – 5 predefined styles (Classic, Icon Left, Bordered, Background, Modern Plus) with badge icon, expandable question and answer list.
  • Tabs – Horizontal or vertical tabbed content.
  • Timeline – Vertical timeline with date, title, and description per item.
  • Image Gallery – Grid gallery with optional lightbox.
  • Video Popup – YouTube/Vimeo video in a modal popup.
  • Before/After Image – Draggable comparison slider.
  • Flip Box – 5 predefined styles (Classic, Gradient, Icon Top, Image Background, Outline Minimal) that flip on hover to reveal more content.

All widgets are fully customizable using Elementor’s native controls, including typography, colors, spacing, borders, and box shadows.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the tmxkit-addons-for-elementor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated.
  4. Open Elementor editor, and you will find the tmxkit-addons-for-elementor widgets in the TMXKit category.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor to use tmxkit-addons-for-elementor?

Yes, tmxkit-addons-for-elementor requires Elementor to be installed and active. The plugin will show an admin notice if Elementor is missing.

Can I use custom icons in the Icon Box?

Yes, tmxkit-addons-for-elementor uses Elementor’s Icon Manager, supporting Font Awesome and Elementor’s icon libraries.

Is tmxkit-addons-for-elementor compatible with all themes?

tmxkit-addons-for-elementor is designed to work with any theme compatible with Elementor.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Counter: added 5 predefined styles (Modern Minimal, Dark, Boxed, Background Image, Split) with an optional background image.
  • Flip Box: added 5 predefined styles (Classic, Gradient, Icon Top, Image Background, Outline Minimal). Front side now supports a description and a “View Details” link; back side’s link now renders as a proper button with customizable text.
  • Pricing Table: added 5 predefined styles (Clean Minimal, Gradient Highlight, Modern with Icon, Dark, Bordered Classic) with an optional plan icon badge for the “Modern with Icon” style.
  • Advanced Button: added 10 predefined button styles (Gradient Fill, Outline Modern, Minimal Text, White on Dark, Soft Background, Gradient Border, Pill, Glassmorphism, Classic Solid, Icon Circle). Existing manual Style-tab controls (color, background, border, radius, shadow, padding) still override the chosen preset.
  • FAQ Accordion: added 5 predefined styles (Classic, Icon Left, Bordered, Background, Modern Plus), a colored badge icon that switches between + and − on toggle, a chevron indicator, and an “Open First Item by Default” option.
  • Image Box: added 5 predefined card styles (Gradient, Minimal, Glass, Dark, Outline), matching Icon Box’s style system — with a small decorative “badge” icon, a “Learn More” link with Normal/Hover colors, optional background decoration, and full-featured image/content style controls.
  • Icon Box: “Icon Size” and “Icon Shape Size” sliders now have proper default values (26px / 64px) matching what’s actually rendered, instead of showing blank in the panel.
  • Hero Slider now correctly declares its script dependency (previously loaded inconsistently).

1.1.0

  • Added 15 new widgets: Advanced Heading, Advanced Button, Counter, Pricing Table, Testimonial, Team Member, Call to Action, Progress Bar, FAQ Accordion, Tabs, Timeline, Image Gallery, Video Popup, Before/After Image, Flip Box.
  • Added 5 predefined card styles to Icon Box (Gradient, Minimal, Glass, Dark, Outline).
  • Fixed: icon controls (Icon Box, Advanced Button, Counter, Team Member, Flip Box) rendered a literal “1” instead of the icon due to incorrect use of the Elementor icon renderer.
  • Fixed: plugin styles/scripts failed to load inside the Elementor editor preview because they were only registered on a frontend-only hook.
  • Fixed: widget category was never registered with Elementor.
  • Fixed: language folder path mismatch that prevented translations from loading.
  • Renamed deprecated _register_controls() to register_controls() across all widgets.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of tmxkit-addons-for-elementor Elementor Addons.
  • Added Hero Slider, Icon Box, Image Box, Nav Menu, and Site Logo widgets.
  • Full Elementor styling support for typography, colors, spacing, borders, and shadows.
